scripts.sync-keys: mkdir -p pkgs/app/public/managed/judge && cp -Rf pkgs/contract/src/managed/judge/keys pkgs/app/public/managed/judge/ && cp -Rf pkgs/contract/src/managed/judge/zkir pkgs/app/public/managed/judge/
scripts.build: bun run --cwd pkgs/contract build && bun run sync-keys && bun run --cwd pkgs/shared build && bun run --cwd pkgs/cli build && bun run --cwd pkgs/app build
scripts.build:app: bun run --cwd pkgs/contract build && bun run sync-keys && bun run --cwd pkgs/shared build && bun run --cwd pkgs/app build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd pkgs/shared build && bun run --cwd pkgs/app build && bun run --cwd pkgs/cli typecheck && bun run --cwd pkgs/contract build
